tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// dpal ma hā mā yā gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan bde chen mgon po la// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis 'dud// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rim las 'ongs// dran pa gcig pa bshad par bya// grub pa'i slob dpon byā da lis mdzad pa'i ma hā mā yā'i sgrub thabs dran pa gcig pa bsgom par 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥ'i 'od kyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar phaiṃ zhes spyan drangs/ yid kyis sprul ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags don bsam/ hūm̐ yig las rang gi mdun du snod kyi 'jig rten rnam par dag pa padma dang*/ zla ba dmar skya'i gdan la/ hrīḥlas dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo sku mdog sngon mo zhal bzhi sngo ser dmar ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis thod pa dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs 'phyar ba/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo rang mtshungs dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ mgo phreng phyag rgya lnga'i rgyan dang bcas pa/ de la yid kyis mchod pa phul/ de nyid rang gi snying nang du thim pas/ rang nyid he ru ka'i sku snga ma bzhin du gyur pa la/ spro na go cha'i yi ge rnams dgod de/ mgrin par āḥ rna ba gnyis la a/ mig la oṃ rnams dmar po/ sna la kham̐ dkar po/ dpral bar tsi ser po/ snying gar ra dmar po'o// dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ aḥ.am̐ hūm̐/ zhes bzlas pa ci nus bya'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'ang ci nus su bsgom ste/ bde chen myur sgrub tu bshad zin to// gtor ma 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/

ye shes pa skad cig gis mdun du byon pa la/ oṃ āḥgu hya ā bhakṣa bhakṣai hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ de rang la bstim/ byin rlabs ni/ chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum gyi dbus su thig le dkar po yod pa zhig bri/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ mngon rtogs bsgoms nas gtor ma gong bzhin 'bul/ mchod pa'ang 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas yid kyis phul/ slob mas maṇḍal byas nas/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i// he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sgrub thabs kyi dmigs pa phog nas/ sngags bzlar bcug bum dbang ngo*// zhes brda sprad/ snying gar nyi zla kha sbyor rgya sran tsam pa'i dbus su/ thig le yungs 'bru tsam la sems gtod du gzhug brjod bral gyi nyams myong ngo sprad la gsang dbang ngo*// zhes brjod/ lte ba'i a yig 'bar bas/ spyi bo'i ham̐ zhu bar dmigs la rlung bzung du bcug thur sel bsdams pas bde stong gi nyams skyes par bsam/ sher dbang ngo*// chos 'byung ni dbyings spros bral/ thig le ni rig pa bde ba chen po'i brda'o zhes dbang bzhi pa'o// 'di la rjes chog mi dgos/ rab zab ma hā mā yā'i gzhung*// kun gyi zab don dga' bas zhus// yang snying len tshul 'di 'dra ba// gzhan la yod med gsal por smros// ma hā mā yā gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs kyi le'u tshan no// ༈ /bde chen myur sgrub bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ na mo badzra ḍā kā ya/ dran pa gcig pa zhes bya ba// bde chen myur du sgrub pa'i thabs// sgyu 'phrul chen mo gtso bo la// btud nas bdag gis te bor bri// zab mo'i rgyud sde chen po ma hā mā yā'i dgongs don dran pa gcig pa nyams su len par 'dod pas/ dang por bskyed rim dran pa gcig pa la/

yab yum la brten pa gnyis las/ thog ma ni/ skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje mkha' 'gror gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba la hrīḥsngon po/ de las 'od 'phros/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ phyag 'tshal/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms te rang la bstim/ shū n+ya tā sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du hūm̐ las srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chud pa'i dngos grub ster ba'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su chu skyes dmar po kun nas kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'od phung dkrigs pa'i lte ba la/ āḥlas zla ba dmar po dang*/ hrīḥlas dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ind+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ sgeg cing mkhrang bag chags pa/ sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mda' gzhu kha ṭwāṃ ga ka pā la 'dzin pa'i phyag gzhi pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang mgo bo'i phreng ba can/ skra gyen du brdzes shing*/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi gar stabs can/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la hrīḥbasams nas/ mdun gyi he ru ka la phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ mche ba gtsigs shing sogs kyis bstod/ rdo rje he ru kas bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig ces gsol ba btab pas/ he ru ka'i snying ga'i hūm̐ḥdang*/ srung 'khor sogs lus la thim pas/ lus rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ hūm̐ḥyig brten pa'i dkyil 'khor he ru kar gsal bar gyur/ nus na lha lnga ka'ang gsal 'debs/ nang gi he ru ka'i thugs kar zla nyi'i bar du hrīḥgasang sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa la rtse gcig tu dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes bzla/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i lha'i rang bzhin du shes par byas te dge ba bsngos nas thun mtshams la 'jug go /phyi ma yum la brten pa ni/

phal cher snga ma nyid las khyad par ni/ sa bon hūm̐ gi gnas su oṃ dkar po bkod/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma yab dang 'dra ba las/ skra grol gcer bu lha mo'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa/ rang snang gi yab dang sbyor ba/ de'i mig gnyis su oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ dpral bar rtsi ser po/ rna ba gnyis la a dmar po/ snar kham̐ dkar po/ snying gar ra dmar po/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod pa yan chad sngar bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ am̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ sngags so// de nas rdzogs rim dran pa gcig pa ni/ lus gnad rtsa'i chun po'i 'dug stangs sam/ rdo rje dang*/ padma dang srog shing gi skyil krung gang rung can gyi chos bdun bcas rang lhar gsal ba'i a wa dhu ti'i nang nam mkha'i rlung dwangs mas gang bas de'i nang gi spyi bor rlung sngon po zla gam/ mgrin par me dmar po gru gsum/ lte bar sa ser po gru bzhi/ snying gar chu dkar po zlum po rnams bsgoms nas 'khor lo ltar bskor bas rlung ro lan gsum bus/ rngubs pas spyi bo'i rlung sngo bun pa dang*/ mgrin pa'i me dmar lhab song ba gnyis snying gar gcig tu 'dres nyi mar gyur/ thur sel drangs pas/ lte ba'i sa gser zhun ma lta bu dang*/ snying ga'i chu zla 'od ltar dkar phyur ba gnyis snying gar 'dres zla bar gyur/ nyi zla steng 'og 'gyur te zla ba steng du sa bon/ de gnyis kyi dbus su nam mkha'i rlung sems dbyer med ma hūm̐ gi rnam par gnas pa/ dper na ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su nor bu bcug pa lta bu/ de la rtse gcig tu bsgrims nas gzhag des skyo na hūm̐ las rlung 'od kyi bdag nyid byung*/ zla ba sing sgra dang bcas nas phug zla ba'i bu ga nas 'gro 'ong byed par bsam/ yi ge gsum gyi gdangs dang bcas te rdor bzlas bya/ dmigs pas lhag par skyo na brtan g.yo'i yul sna tshogs la dmigs nas 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/

yul gyi bcud bsdu ba'i bzlas pa bya ste/ thog mar oṃ gyis dbyung*/ hūm̐ gis rngub/ āḥyis bkag pa'i rdor bzlas so// slar yang zla ba'i bug pa nas hūm̐ la sems gtad/ rlung mi bde ba med tsam du bzung*/ de nas dal bus bus la drag tu rngubs nas 'dzin/ de kho na rtag tu bsgom par bya'o// des ma grub na rba rlabs btsir ba'i ye shes lan 'ga' re bzung nas seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgya bsgrubs rjes sngar gyi rnal 'byor la sbyar bas 'grub bo// rdor bzlas gtso bo yin la 'di gnyis bogs 'don te/ de'i tshe sems yud gcig gnas la yud gcig mi gnas pa de'i tshe/ smig rgyu ltar 'od kyi drwa ba mthong*/ de'i tshe bar 'gang chu rlung gcod pa ste nā da'i tshe de'i rlung sbyor yang bag re bya'o// 'dis bogs 'don pa 'og rnams la'ang mtshon no// de ni rang gar rgyu ba las 'phral du 'gro 'ong 'gog pa ste/ lte bar drag tu kha sbyar bas lus kun khyab par bsam mo// de nas rtsol bar byas na gang 'dod kyi bar du gnas la med par 'dod na yang med par 'gro ba na du ba dang sprin gyi rnam pa mthong ngo*// de nas rtsol med du gnas la ci 'dod du ldang nus pa nam mkha'i snang ba lta bu mthong ngo*// de nas sems gnas pa'i mthu las snang ba kun gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong sang nge bar gyur pa na mar me lta bu mthong ngo*// kun gyi tha mar shin tu sbyangs pa'i lus sems kyi bde ba dang stong pa dbyer med du shar ba na nam mkha' sprin med kyi snang ba 'byung ste rtags lnga'o// dmigs pa la sems gnas tsam dang*/ lus sems bde stong tsam rim pa dang pos kyang 'grub mod/ gnas skabs lnga po 'di dag la sgrub tshul thun mong ma yin pa re yod pa'ang shes dgos la/ de brtan par gyur na lus gnad la nges pa med pas rlung sbyor snga ma dang 'dra ba las rngubs pa'ang dal bus byas la dmigs pa hūm̐ gi 'od zer dri ma med pas khams gsum 'od du zhu rang la thim/

yang yang de nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas rlung rgyu ba mi mngon pa tsam du 'gyur/ de yang je phra la stong par sbyang*/ de ltar yang yang goms pas rlung dhu tir 'chings la/ de nas stong pa las rlung ldang ba dang lhan cig lha sku rnam pa thams cad du bsgom pa slar nas slar du bsgom/ 'di kho nas kyang yon tan brgyad 'byung la/ phal cher ni yon tan brgyad las kyi phyag rgya las 'thob bo// de ltar dga' bzhi stong pa don dam pa la sbyar nas lha sku bde ba chen por bskyed de/ 'dod yon lnga la spyod na dga' bzhi'i skad cig ngos zin pas stong nyid du bsgrub par bya ste/ mthar gyis dngos grub mchog la sbyor ba'o// bza' ba'i dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ye shes bdud rtsir bsgoms la/ oṃ āḥgu hya bhakṣe hūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas tha mal gyi rnam rtog spangs la longs spyad/ nyal ba'i tshe dang po'i rnal 'byor pas snang ba kun bsdu rim gyis bsdus nas dmigs med kyi ngang la nyal zhing*/ gnyid pa'i gnas skabs rmi lam gyi man ngag la sbyor zhing*/ gsum pa'i skabs su bde ba chen po'i lha'i sku bsgrub par bya ba nyid yin te/ de gnyis kyi man ngag ni gzhan du rtogs par bya'o// bde chen 'dus ma byas pa'i rang nyams las// dbang sngon 'od brgya'i dpal 'dzin longs spyod rdzogs// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gtso myur 'grub byed// bla ma dam pa'i man ngag ji bzhin bkod// lugs 'di la 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor zur du ston par snang*/ lhag ma dbyibs sngags chos gsum gyi snying po mchog tu gyur pa 'di'ang tā ra nā thas rang lo nyi shu pa la'o// 'di la man ngag gnyis pa gzhan ni cis kyang gal che'o// ༈ /dpal ma hā mā yā gtso rkyang gi byin rlabs kyi cho ga 'od gsal 'char ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bcom ldan ma hā mā yā dang*// dbyer med khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs// snying dbus thig ler mchod byas nas// byin rlabs cho ga cung zad 'bri// 'di la gnyis/

sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ gnas dben par stegs bu'i khar maṇḍa lar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum gyi dbus su thig le dkar po yod pa zhig 'bri/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dang*/ gtor 'bul/ yid mchod rnams gzhung ltar bya/ maṇḍal ni dbang bzhi pa'i brda don ngo sprod pa'i ched du bsham pa las lha bskyed pa sogs mi dgos so// gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod par sems bskyed gsal 'debs sogs ji ltar rigs pas mtshams sbyar te/ de la rnal 'byor bla med ma rgyud sgo drug gi ya gyal he ru ka'i rigs dpal ma hā mā yā la 'phags yul du gtso bor grub pa'i slob dpon chen po kukku ri las legs par bkral zhing*/ gzhan yang slob dpon 'dul bas byin dang*/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba sogs kyis kyang bka' srol mi 'dra ba re re dar bar mdzad pa dang*/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir jo bo rje dang*/ mar 'gos rnam gnyis kyis bsgyur bshad 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab pas mtshon dar rgyas su gyur pa lags/ 'dir grub chen kukku ri pa las slob dpon dharma pas gsan/ de las grub thob byā da li pas gsan nas sgrub thabs dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor mdzad pa nas rim par brgyud de/ grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs yab sras kyi thugs dam/ mkhas grub chen po kun dga' snying po la bka' babs pa'i dpal ma hā mā yā gtso rkyang gi byin rlabs kyi rim pa zab mo sgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i// he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de nas slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hrīḥ'i 'od kyis/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar phaiṃ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ yid kyis sprul pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod pa'i mos pa sngon du 'gro bas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig dkon mchog gsum la sogs/ dngos gzhi bum pa'i dbang gi slad du/ oṃ shū n+ya tā nas/ haṃ zhes pa'i don gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa de kho na nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o snyam du cung zad re mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ de'i ngang las rang rang gi mdun du hūm̐ yig las snod kyi 'jig rten sogs nas/ mchod pa phul bas de nyid rang rang gi snying nang du thim pas/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dpal he ru ka sgyu 'phrul chen mo nas/ rgyan dang bcas pa'i skur lam ste gyur pa'i mgrin par āḥnas thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla nyi kha sbyor gyi bar du hrīḥyig sngon po gsang sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog pa la rtse gcig tu sems gtad nas sngags 'di gsung bar zhu/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐/ zhes ji ltar rigs pa bzlar gzhug de ni bum pa'i dbang gi ngo bo'o// gsang dbang gi slad du/ rang rang gi snying gar nyi zla kha sbyor rgya sran tsam pa'i dbus su/ thig le yungs 'bru tsam la sems gtad de cung zad re mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ de ltar bzhag pas gnas lugs brjod bral gyi ye shes nyams su myong ba ni gsang ba'i dbang gi ngo bo'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du/ khyed rang rnams phyi dbyibs kyi lus dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mor gsal bzhin pa'i lte ba'i a yig la sems gtad pas/ de las me dmar khyug gis 'bar/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu bas lus khyab par mos te rlung kha sbyar du bzung la cung zad re mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ de las bde stong gi nyams skyes pa ni dbang gsum pa'i ngo bo'o// dbang bzhi pa ni/

brda la brten nas don ngo sprad pa ste/ mdun du bshams pa'i maṇḍal gyi chos 'byung dmar po 'di ni dbyings spros bral/ de'i dbus su thig le dkar po ni rig pa bde ba chen po'i brda'o// de ltar ngo sprad pas sems nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med du mtshon pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo'o// des byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi grub nas/ mjug dam tshig khas blang ba sogs spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ slob dpon gyis rjes chog gi bya ba ci'ang mi dgos so// dran pas lhan cig skyed pa yi// bde chen 'od gsal 'char ba'i lam// byin rlabs rim pa 'di bgyis pas// 'gro kun he ru ka thob shog /ces pa'ang rang 'dra'i blo dman rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i ched du/ bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos shing rta chen po kun dga' snying po'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ji lta bar bklag pas grub par bsdebs pa sarba dā shre yo bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
